product.description: Monoprice™Mid‑Size Keystone Plate 6‑Port, UL®Reliable Cabling Solution with Six Openings for Network, Audio, Video, and Data ConnectionsThe Mid-Size Keystone Plate 6‑Port, UL Listed is a high‑quality solution designed to support professional‑grade networking, audio, and video installations. Built for both residential and commercial environments, this mid‑size wall plate combines durability, functionality, and style in a sleek form factor. With six available ports, it provides ample capacity for organizing multiple connections in one convenient location, ensuring a neat, efficient, and professional‑looking setup.Crafted with precision and tested to meet UL standards, this keystone plate guarantees safety, performance, and long‑lasting reliability. The mid‑size design offers a slightly larger coverage compared to standard wall plates, making it an excellent choice for installations where wall imperfections or oversized junction boxes need to be concealed. This feature not only enhances the aesthetic appeal but also ensures a polished and professional finish in any setting.The Mid‑Size Keystone Plate 6‑Port accommodates a wide variety of keystone jacks, including data, voice, audio, video, and fiber modules, allowing maximum flexibility to meet diverse cabling needs. Whether you're wiring a modern office, setting up a structured home network, or upgrading an AV system, this six‑port keystone plate is engineered to adapt to different applications with ease.To complement various décor styles and preferences, the plate is available in three versatile color options: Black, Gray, and Ultra White. These finishes blend seamlessly into any interior environment‑from corporate offices to residential living spaces‑ensuring a clean and professional appearance. The smooth surface is easy to clean and resistant to wear, maintaining its look even with frequent use.Installation is simple and efficient thanks to its user‑friendly design. The keystone plate supports quick mounting with standard wall boxes and compatible hardware, while securely holding keystone jacks in place. Its rugged construction ensures it can withstand everyday handling while maintaining stability for all connected modules.For installers, IT professionals, and homeowners alike, the Mid‑Size Keystone Plate 6‑Port offers the ideal balance of capacity, quality, and visual appeal. Its UL certification provides added peace of mind, ensuring compliance with safety standards while delivering dependable performance.In summary, the Mid‑Size Keystone Plate 6‑Port is the perfect choice when you need a reliable, stylish, and versatile solution for structured cabling.
